title: UX-01 task 6: the pack-opening reference
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 6 (standard §23, design screen 4): ProductChoice (held product with a quiet artwork slot; opening is free and never a purchase), RevealCard (face down with the official card back, then the card with rarity, Foil and New as text; a card turn in the major-motion duration; the rarest beat as light from the card's ink identity behind the card within the reward-beat token, with a forced-colours outline), PackReveal (ordered list, six columns from 64 rem and four below), RevealControls (Reveal next, Reveal all and Skip to summary, none waiting on decoration) and OpeningSummary (every card with labels, the new-card count and per-card View in Collection links, withheld with a reason while settlement is pending). Component tokens pack.product, pack.perspective, pack.summary-item, pack.summary-card and pack.reveal-max; 15 component strings.

stories/support/reference/pack.ts: the fixture's 12-card demonstration pack in reveal order (6 common, 3 uncommon, a Rare, the King Louie foil and Powerline – Megastar, Legendary, last), with New derived from the binder's demonstration holdings. Packs.stories.tsx composes the flow (choose, Confirmation review, indeterminate pending, reveal with announcements, summary) and stories for every design state plus none held; the Collection story takes a page argument so summary links land on each card's page.

Seven pack browser tests in reference.spec.ts. One defect they found was fixed before the receipt: the review dialog's close reset the flow after confirming, so pending never showed. RUN-20261022-026 passes the gates and 332/332 Chromium tests.

Visual review at 1440 x 900 (Paper and Ink) and 820 x 1180 found the second card row below the fold; the reveal stage is capped at 66 rem so both rows fit. The rarest beat reads as restrained light behind the card in both themes. Captures are in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/.
